proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that in any twelve-month period, the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure spread on any given hectare of land on the holding does not exceed 250kg.
label: Nitrogen limit in organic manure (250kg/ha/year)

conditions: exception: if the three conditions for certified green compost or certified green/food compost are met (paragraphs 3–5)
exception: if the low-intensity grassland requirements in paragraph (7) are met and recorded (paragraph 6)
affected_subjects: 250kg per hectare in any twelve-month period
notes: Core nitrogen limit obligation with clear subject, rule, object, and temporal scope; exceptions enumerated separately.

proposition_text: For the low-intensity grassland exemption, at least 80% of the holding's agricultural area must be sown with grass throughout the year, total nitrogen in organic manure must not exceed 100kg per hectare, total nitrogen from manufactured fertiliser must not exceed 90kg per hectare, and the occupier must not bring organic manure onto the holding.
label: Low-intensity grassland requirements (80% grass, 100kg organic N, 90kg manufactured N, no imports)
affected_subjects: at least 80% grass cover, ≤100kg/ha organic manure nitrogen, ≤90kg/ha manufactured nitrogen fertiliser, and no organic manure brought onto the holding
notes: Four distinct requirements (a)–(d) for low-intensity exemption; combined into one proposition as they form a conjunctive test.
review_notes: Four distinct requirements (a)–(d) for low-intensity exemption; combined into one proposition as they form a conjunctive test.

extraction_debug_meta.evidence_quote: The requirements in this paragraph are that throughout the year concerned— a at least 80% of the holding's agricultural area is sown with grass, b the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure applied to the holding, whether directly by an animal or spreading, does not exceed 100kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares, c the total amount of nitrogen from manufactured nitrogen fertiliser applied to the holding does not exceed 90kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares, and d the occupier does not bring organic manure on to the holding.
